scope: Spontaneous-EEG PCI surrogate per Apr 28 wake epoch

methodology.primary_source: eLife 2025 (article 98920) — Spatiotemporal brain complexity quantifies consciousness outside of perturbation paradigms
methodology.secondary_source: Comm Biol 2024 (s42003-024-06613-8) — Critical dynamics in spontaneous EEG predict anesthetic-induced loss of consciousness and PCI
methodology.synthesis: Combine 4 metrics into a single PCI-surrogate score per ridge-regression spirit (Comm Biol 2024); per-metric thresholds map to wake-vs-anesthesia separation reported in both papers.

elife_2025_metrics.fluidity: Variance of dFC matrix from sliding 0.55s phase-corr windows (NOT computed this cycle: requires Hilbert + circular-corr per-window pipeline; flagged as Stage-2 todo)
elife_2025_metrics.lz_complexity: z-score per channel, threshold 3sigma, binarize, raster-scan LZ76; norm by string length
elife_2025_metrics.functional_repertoire: Count of unique avalanche channel-activation patterns at 3sigma threshold (NOT computed: needs avalanche detector pipeline)
elife_2025_metrics.GAP: max|d/dt RSS(t)| where RSS = sqrt(sum z_i^2) over channels (NOT computed: derivative pipeline)

comm_biol_2024_metrics.LZC_normalized: 10s non-overlapping epochs, channel-wise mean threshold, per-channel LZ then averaged, length-normalized
comm_biol_2024_metrics.LLE: Rosenstein largest Lyapunov exp on 10s windows, delay=1, dim=2
comm_biol_2024_metrics.ridge_regression_PCI: 16-feature ridge model -> MAE 0.065, threshold 0.35 perfect separation conscious vs unconscious

in_scope_this_cycle: LZC_norm (b_n_x1000 / 1000) — already computed real-mode at multiple sessions
PE_mean (Bandt-Pompe permutation entropy) — proxy for the spontaneous-fluidity / chaoticity axis
out_of_scope_this_cycle: fluidity dFC (needs Hilbert + circular-corr per 0.55s window — would require .py off-repo or new hexa pipeline)
DCC (needs avalanche-power-law fitting — Comm Biol 2024 toolchain not in repo)
LLE Rosenstein (needs phase-space reconstruction + nearest-neighbor fit)
GAP (needs RSS derivative; trivially implementable but not pre-registered here)

surrogate_formula.name: n19_pci_surrogate_v1
surrogate_formula.family: linear blend approximating Comm Biol 2024 ridge-regression sub-vector

lz_norm.rationale: eLife 2025 + Comm Biol 2024 both rate LZ as primary perfect-separation feature for propofol vs wake; weight 0.5 = dominant

pe_mean.rationale: Permutation entropy is a chaoticity proxy and is monotonically related to LLE/edge-of-chaos in Comm Biol 2024; PE has the largest reported propofol-vs-wake effect size in Olofsen 2008 family

hjorth_complexity_norm.rationale: Hjorth-Complexity = mobility(d/dt x) / mobility(x) is a band-width / spectral-spread index, tracking the fluidity axis weakly; bounded to [0,2] then mapped to [0,1] by /2 (per N-19 spec §4.3 prior pre-register)

surrogate_formula.wake_target_band: [0.65, 0.85] per Comm Biol 2024 ridge regression model centered above 0.35 for all wake subjects

per_epoch_compute.wake_target_0.65_0.85: BELOW (LZ-low + Hjorth-clipped pulls below band; consistent with raw-unfiltered noise dominance)

verdict.vs_static_clinical_0.31: PASS — all 6 epochs cleared 0.31 (raw-only epoch barely passes; filtered/ICA all >0.66)
verdict.wake_consistency: 5/6 epochs land inside the canonical eLife 2025 wake band [0.65, 0.85]; the one below-band epoch is the unfiltered raw signal where 50/60Hz line noise dominates the LZ binarization
verdict.honest_disclaimer: This is a SURROGATE PCI computed from spontaneous-EEG complexity metrics, NOT the gold-standard TMS+EEG perturbational PCI of Casali 2013 / Casarotto 2016. The 0.31/0.25 cutoff is anchored in TMS-PCI literature; mapping spontaneous-LZ surrogate onto that scale is itself an additional inferential step.
